decisions.reason: The requested photographs support verification documentation but do not change the existing review scope or required review outcome.
The photographs are verification inputs and do not change the selected stamped concurrence package, its presentation methods, or its confirmation purpose.
Requesting photographs of completed changes has no effect on the Nevada PE name or license attribution.
The source concerns verification of the Nevada as-built changes and does not affect the separate California credential requirement.
Photographic verification of completed Nevada changes does not alter the calculations required for the separate additional permit project.
The source does not change the deliverables or stamp requirement for the separate permit-ready electrical drawing package.
The source's photograph-based change verification is unrelated to the Manual J, S, and D calculation requirements.
